raw.one_liner: Narma-del-u01-r1 is a three-layered AI system for enterprises that observes work patterns, identifies high-ROI AI opportunities, and automatically deploys AI agents to optimize workflows.

market_data.trigger_now: Enterprises often struggle with a lack of telemetry to pinpoint AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant drift in systems and human resources.

core_insight.if_wrong: If the system cannot accurately observe work patterns, detect intent, or identify high-ROI opportunities, the automated deployment of AI agents will not yield the desired 'Continuous AI lift' or optimize enterprise workflows, leading to wasted resources and failed AI implementations.
core_insight.why_different: The venture focuses on a 'Work Graph' model to reveal where resources are burned and where AI can intercept work mid-flow, rather than building its own foundational models. It emphasizes continuous, automated deployment of AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities, with built-in approval gates.
core_insight.source_excerpt: Vision: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a "Continuous AI lift." AI-first companies seeking to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.

raw.product_description: Narma-del-u01-r1 is a three-layered architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence) acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value of tasks, and work "drift." Layer 3 (Execution) is an "Agent Factory" that generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. The system leverages existing foundation models and focuses on a "Work Graph" to identify areas for AI intervention and assistance.
raw.evidence_of_stage: The venture is described as an architectural concept without any mention of development, users, or revenue.
